newsitem.title: UK: Norway's Gullfaks to load 19 Aug cargoes - trade.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Gullfaks to load 19 Aug cargoes - trade.

text.p: Norway's Gullfaks crude system is scheduled to load 19 standard 855,000 barrel cargoes in August, two fewer than last month, traders said.
The total volume in August is expected to be 16.25 million barrels, down 1.7 million barrels from July, and 4.26 million barrels lower than June.

Problems with a compressor in the North Sea Vigdis oilfield have hit production from the Gullfaks system, pushing one cargo back in July but not leading to its cancellation from that month's programme.
The Gullfaks A platform is scheduled to go into maintenance from August 25 to September 19, eating into output in both months.
Preliminary indications for the September Gullfaks programme suggested there would be as few as 10 cargoes, trade sources added.
